messages:
jess: noticed an uptick in failed init for llama4x-fp16 after SDK 4.2.0 rolled to prod. failures show: "shape mismatch: expected [1,2048] got [1,4096]" on model load. anyone seen this?

deploybot: Deploybot: detected model load failures on 0.8% of requests for model=llama4x-fp16 in us-east-1 at 04:10 UTC. No runtime pin currently. (bot)

runtime_ana: that error is consistent with a change in tokenizer batching/slice offsets. SDK 4.2.0 introduced a batching optimization that alters chunk boundaries. runtime 4.0.1 expects prior chunking semantics.

sre_miguel: repro steps: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"llama4x-fp16","input":"x"*3000}'` -> init error. attaching trimmed logs to ticket.

product_ops: can we do a targeted soft-unpin of SDK 4.2.0 for llama4x-fp16 in prod-us-east and staging while teams coordinate? prefer unpin on SDK layer if possible to avoid runtime churn.

release_czar: agree on SDK soft-unpin; rollback policy: if model-load error rate >0.2% for 15m, roll back SDK to 4.1.3 in affected regions; if latency regresses >10% after unpin, abort and escalate. owners: sdk-team + runtime-team.

deploybot: running command: `/deploybot unpin-sdk --model llama4x-fp16 --sdk 4.1.3 --regions us-east-1,staging --duration 3h --notify ops`

opsbot: Note: unpin executed at 7290012360. Routing maintained for 5% canary to 4.2.0 for monitoring.

runtime_ana: FYI I'll add a compatibility test for tokenizer chunking to the nightly matrix and open a follow-up PR recommending an adapter shim in SDK 4.2.x to preserve legacy chunk semantics for pinned models.

jess: thanks. can we also include a short release note: "Temporary SDK pin to 4.1.3 for llama4x-fp16 in us-east & staging due to tokenizer chunking incompatibility observed with SDK 4.2.0. Canary retained at 5% while teams validate shim. Owners: SDK & runtime."

sre_miguel: monitoring dashboards now. will post metrics after 10m.

release_czar: keeping channel open. if green at +30m consider gradual lift of pin and incremental SDK patch release. otherwise will schedule hotfix cycle.
